title: Deck Icon Exploration
summary: Three compact line-icon alternatives for the project Deck: a card stack, layered planes, and a stacked board. Includes light and dark theme proofs, a recommendation, and the exact later implementation seam.

implementationTasks.title: Apply Robert's selected Deck icon
